easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 2 using the Insect token instead.
